usblc6_tp_ds.title: USBLC6-2P6 Low Capacitance TVS Diode Array
usblc6_tp_ds.revision: no revision or date printed; PDF created 2021-08-04
usblc6_tp_ds.note: The datasheet of the part LCSC C2827693 actually is: TECH PUBLIC's second source of ST's USBLC6-2P6, not ST's. 4 pages; printed page numbers equal PDF pages. The PDF is page images with no text layer (pdftotext returns nothing), so its values were read from a 110 dpi rendering and claims cite it with `figure` transcriptions, not searchable quotes. It covers ratings, electrical characteristics, the pin diagram, derating and the SOT-666 outline and land pattern; it has no application circuit and no layout guidance.

usblc6_st_ds.title: USBLC6-2 Very low capacitance ESD protection
usblc6_st_ds.where: The copy read and hashed is LCSC's datasheet link for C15999 (ST's own USBLC6-2P6); st.com (vendor_url) timed out. The same file (same sha256) is easy_pcb's examples/easy2350/design/datasheets/usblc6-2.pdf.
usblc6_st_ds.note: The original part's datasheet, read for what the second source's datasheet lacks: the application (CBUS on VBUS, Figure 18) and the layout guidance (§2.2-2.3). ST has published later revisions; the hash is of Rev 5, which is what was read. Page numbers are the printed 'n/14', equal to PDF pages.
